title: Freya and the Cover
author: Tamsin Eastwick
blurb: Silas Iversen, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
